description: This source file is part of LibXDiff, a library for computing and emitting diffs between files. It contains functions related to emitting diff records, computing hunks for diff output, and handling context lines and function name annotations within diffs.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_record(xdfile_t * xdf,long ri,char const * pre,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Emits a diff record (line) from the specified file object, prepending with a prefix such as ' ' for context, '-' for deletions, or '+' for additions.

methods.name: long saturating_add(long a,long b)
methods.description: Performs addition of two longs with saturation at LONG_MAX to prevent overflow.

methods.name: xdchange_t * xdl_get_hunk(xdchange_t ** xscr,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg)
methods.description: Determines the extent of a diff hunk starting from a change atom, incorporating context and ignored changes based on configuration.

methods.name: long def_ff(const char * rec,long len,char * buf,long sz)
methods.description: Default function to identify lines that look like function definitions or identifiers based on their initial characters.

methods.name: long match_func_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,long ri,char * buf,long sz)
methods.description: Attempts to match a record to a function declaration pattern, using a user-specified find function if provided.

methods.name: int is_func_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,long ri)
methods.description: Checks if a record at a given index in a file matches a function declaration.

methods.name: long get_func_line(xdfenv_t * xe,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,struct func_line * func_line,long start,long limit)
methods.description: Retrieves a line number near a specified start, moving backwards or forwards, that matches a function declaration pattern.

methods.name: int is_empty_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,long ri)
methods.description: Determines whether a record (line) in a file consists only of whitespace.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_diff(xdfenv_t * xe,xdchange_t * xscr,xdemitcb_t * ecb,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg)
methods.description: Main function to emit a unified diff output from two file contents, including context, function names, and diff hunks.
